This fabricates vendor evidence and extract_slugs hits. Most of it is pre-existing: at e14d934 the same set gives 24/52, and at 21606d0 it gives 35/52.

issues.problem: Common English words that are pack aliases or names are not in AMBIGUOUS_NAMES, so they match case-insensitively as vendors with no proper-noun check. 'copilot' is everyday prose in exactly this domain ('an AI copilot'). Devin as a person's first name cannot be told apart lexically. The issue is pre-existing, but it is the same false-tick class the package exists to close.

issues.problem: A maker word exempts the compound check unconditionally, so 'Melty' used generically still yields the product. This is a new false positive compared with e14d934.

issues.suggested_fix: Also require a product cue or a subject verb from the agentic lexicon after '<Maker> <Name>', or accept this as a known residual and pin it in the corpus.

issues.problem: Any negation word in the 48 characters before 'hard exclusion' disables the blanking, even when the negation is about something else. Two regressions against e14d934 tick hard-excluded vendors.

All three gave {} at e14d934. The impact is low because these vendors are excluded from the matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Accept only a negation that governs the marker: r'\b(?:not|never|unlike)\s+(?:on\s+)?(?:a|an|the)?\s*hard[- ]exclusion' (or 'isn't'), not any negation word anywhere in the window.

issues.problem: Absence leaks toward false ticks. A gate verb up to 60 characters before the marker exempts it even when the verb does not govern the marker. An absence sentence that opens with 'However,', or one written as 'This is unresearched.', does not reach the claim before it.
issues.evidence: absence3.py: 'Deepwork blocks nothing and provides workflow composition with no evidence.', 'Deepwork stops at marketing copy and provides workflow composition with no evidence.', 'Deepwork provides workflow composition; however, no independent evidence was found.', 'Deepwork provides workflow composition. However, there are no claims backing this.' and 'Deepwork provides workflow composition. This is unresearched.' -> deepwork WC. The same holds at e14d934. Overall 10/28 leaks (e14d934: 14/28).
issues.suggested_fix: Accept the gate verb only when it is followed by an object and then with|without|on (for example '<gate verb> <noun phrase of up to 4 words> (?:with|without|on) (?:no|missing)'). Add however|this is|this was|it is to _ANAPHORIC_LEAD. Pin the new cases.
